title_zh: 商定虚构噪声数据的谨慎因果表述

scenario.label_zh: 商定虚构噪声数据的谨慎因果表述
scenario.goal_zh: 区分头痛报告发生率与因果结论，并商定保留不确定性的报告表述

context_zh: 数据素养课堂使用教师编造的噪声与头痛问卷结果，只练习证据表达，不构成健康判断。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Freya
sentences.text: In this practice dataset, the incidence of reported headaches is higher on noisy shifts.

sentences.speaker: Anton
sentences.text: Does that prove noise caused the headaches?

sentences.speaker: Freya
sentences.text: No. The questionnaire does not control for hours worked or lack of sleep.

sentences.speaker: Anton
sentences.text: Then saying it proves harm would heighten concern beyond what these data support.

sentences.speaker: Freya
sentences.text: I will write that the reports occur more often on noisy shifts, but the reason is not established.

sentences.speaker: Anton
sentences.text: Good. Include the missing information about working hours and sleep too.
